race.comment: SIMPLY SMASHING (4) gets the nod on exposed form and time profile. She has two placings around 1000m and the Jundah run prior had excuses after she jumped awkwardly and laid in. EFUGI (3) is the key unknown, making her debut for Bevan Johnson after a close third in her latest Pakenham trial, with barrier 1 and a 1.5kg claim giving her a neat starting point. TIME FOR PLAY (7) is another first starter and has trialled at Warwick some time back. Will pay to watch for a market push. PRINCE SEVRES (1) best of the rest.
